mutants.name: M6-revert-lint-weakspots-pattern
mutants.why: Thread 63: plan_lint must also recognise hyphenated 'Weak-spots' as valid so that a correctly-spelled plan does not WARN. Reverting to \s* causes hyphenated plans to trigger a spurious WARN.

mutants.name: M7-invert-receipt-first-check
mutants.why: Thread 77: rule_20_self_check reads the FIRST .md in QA Deposits as the QA report. The (u) WARN fires when the first .md is NOT a receipt. Inverting the condition suppresses the WARN when it should fire and fires it when it should not.
